name: shai-voice-assistant
description: Exact voice assistant module extracted from SHAI Agent AI (Flask + Vanilla JS project). Uses native Web Speech API.

notes.no_third_party_speech: The project uses ONLY the browser-native Web Speech API (webkitSpeechRecognition / SpeechRecognition). No external STT/TTS library is used.
notes.no_audio_context: The project does NOT use AudioContext, AnalyserNode, or MediaRecorder.
notes.no_framer_motion: The project uses CSS keyframe animations only. Framer Motion is NOT used.
notes.no_ai_sdk: NLP/intent parsing happens server-side in Python. There is no client-side AI SDK.
notes.fontawesome: Icons use Font Awesome 6 CDN. Add <link rel='stylesheet' href='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css'> to your index.html.
notes.fonts: The project uses Poppins from Google Fonts. Add the Poppins link to index.html.
